input.old_string: a filter may add or alter sprites and gauges but never remove a hiss, a cold or a thin-air, and `alarm_eligible` never first. *Alternative considered:* a content guideline
input.new_string: a filter may add or alter sprites and gauges but never remove a hiss, a cold or a thin-air, and `alarm_eligible` never first. **Alarm capability, compartment gate, scope, exemption** *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix; Blocker 2: the owner adds the surface, the consumers' ruled behaviour — Suit `suit.alarm`, HUD sixth mark, Audio annunciator — is the spec, G6)*: **(a) Capability.** `alarm_capable(mode)` is true for modes 1-10 and 20-23 (unchanged for 1-10) and FALSE BY DEFINITION, whatever `ALARM_SEV_MIN` (range 2-4), for 24 AIRFLOW, 25 PUDDLE, 26 SEAL_STRAIN and 27 PATCH_WEEP. OPENING descriptors therefore need no gate input; the alarm presentation of a decompression rides the room's ATMO_DECOMP (LS-14 already says so). **(b) Compartment gate input.** Each compartment carries three persisted warn trackers, one per band state machine: `o2` (drives ATMO_THIN: THIN 1, HYPOXIC 3, ANOXIC 4), `p` (ATMO_DECOMP: LOW 2, DECOMP 3, VACUUM 4) and `t` (ATMO_COLD: COOL 1, FROST 2, FREEZING 3, DEEP_COLD 4; ATMO_HOT: HOT 2, SCORCH 4; exclusive). Tracker x = `warn_since_x` (i32) plus bit x of `warn_bits` (u8). In phase 9, compartment id ascending after nodes and edges, with `sev_x` = severity of the descriptor `band_x` currently maps to (0 if none): `sev_x` ≥ 1 and bit clear → set the bit, `warn_since_x` = `step_no`; `sev_x` = 0 → clear the bit, `warn_since_x` = 0. A worsening (THIN → HYPOXIC) does not reset the window; any return to OK does (the band hysteresis `H` is the only debounce). `warn_elapsed_x` = `step_no − warn_since_x` if the bit is set, else 0; `gate_open` = `warn_elapsed_x ≥ W_MIN_STEPS` (100). The gate delays no physics (a compartment has no `hp`); it only withholds `alarm_eligible`. M1 may supply back-dated `warn_since_x` for an authored derelict room as for nodes; absent one the tracker opens on the first run, so a room authored thin or empty is silent for its first 100 steps and the body cues come first (R7/R17). Cost: three compares per compartment per run. **(c) Alarm scope = the loop set.** The Graph publishes one pure read `alarm_sections() -> PackedInt32Array`: ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s (`section_of(compartment_id)` of the descriptor) owning at least one descriptor with `alarm_eligible` true in the last committed run; empty = no alarm. The "seat's loop set" (Suit SE-29, HUD HS-25 / OQ-HS-79) and the "listener's body" (Audio AA-27) are ONE predicate: all six loops (0..5, compartment descriptors included) of every section of the body the seat or listener stands on; a consumer tests `alarm_sections()` ∩ `sections_of(body_of(section_id))` non-empty with Layout's pure reads. Consequences: a derelict breach IS in the seat's loop set (OQ-HS-79 (1): yes); a home-ship fault alarms a seat on the home body; a fault on another body does not. The read names no loop or place beyond sections the consumer already knows. **(d) CX-A1 — exemption.** The Graph's annunciator `ann` (Audio AA-27) is gated by `alarm_eligible`; Attention's breach-entry `attn` cadence (Attention AT-18, Audio AA-20) is Attention's own tell-contract event, not a Graph descriptor, and is preceded by a tell of at least `TELL_MIN_TICKS` by construction, so it is exempt from this gate and is never "the first warning". This closes CX-A1 (the Section H lint already carries the exemption). *Alternative considered:* a content guideline

input.new_string: a filter may add or alter sprites and gauges but never remove a hiss, a cold or a thin-air, and `alarm_eligible` never first. **Alarm capability, compartment gate, scope, exemption** *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix; Blocker 2: the owner adds the surface, the consumers' ruled behaviour — Suit `suit.alarm`, HUD sixth mark, Audio annunciator — is the spec, G6)*: **(a) Capability.** `alarm_capable(mode)` is true for modes 1-10 and 20-23 (unchanged for 1-10) and FALSE BY DEFINITION, whatever `ALARM_SEV_MIN` (range 2-4), for 24 AIRFLOW, 25 PUDDLE, 26 SEAL_STRAIN and 27 PATCH_WEEP. OPENING descriptors therefore need no gate input; the alarm presentation of a decompression rides the room's ATMO_DECOMP (LS-14 already says so). **(b) Compartment gate input.** Each compartment carries three persisted warn trackers, one per band state machine: `o2` (drives ATMO_THIN: THIN 1, HYPOXIC 3, ANOXIC 4), `p` (ATMO_DECOMP: LOW 2, DECOMP 3, VACUUM 4) and `t` (ATMO_COLD: COOL 1, FROST 2, FREEZING 3, DEEP_COLD 4; ATMO_HOT: HOT 2, SCORCH 4; exclusive). Tracker x = `warn_since_x` (i32) plus bit x of `warn_bits` (u8). In phase 9, compartment id ascending after nodes and edges, with `sev_x` = severity of the descriptor `band_x` currently maps to (0 if none): `sev_x` ≥ 1 and bit clear → set the bit, `warn_since_x` = `step_no`; `sev_x` = 0 → clear the bit, `warn_since_x` = 0. A worsening (THIN → HYPOXIC) does not reset the window; any return to OK does (the band hysteresis `H` is the only debounce). `warn_elapsed_x` = `step_no − warn_since_x` if the bit is set, else 0; `gate_open` = `warn_elapsed_x ≥ W_MIN_STEPS` (100). The gate delays no physics (a compartment has no `hp`); it only withholds `alarm_eligible`. M1 may supply back-dated `warn_since_x` for an authored derelict room as for nodes; absent one the tracker opens on the first run, so a room authored thin or empty is silent for its first 100 steps and the body cues come first (R7/R17). Cost: three compares per compartment per run. **(c) Alarm scope = the loop set.** The Graph publishes one pure read `alarm_sections() -> PackedInt32Array`: ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s (`section_of(compartment_id)` of the descriptor) owning at least one descriptor with `alarm_eligible` true in the last committed run; empty = no alarm. The "seat's loop set" (Suit SE-29, HUD HS-25 / OQ-HS-79) and the "listener's body" (Audio AA-27) are ONE predicate: all six loops (0..5, compartment descriptors included) of every section of the body the seat or listener stands on; a consumer tests `alarm_sections()` ∩ `sections_of(body_of(section_id))` non-empty with Layout's pure reads. Consequences: a derelict breach IS in the seat's loop set (OQ-HS-79 (1): yes); a home-ship fault alarms a seat on the home body; a fault on another body does not. The read names no loop or place beyond sections the consumer already knows. **(d) CX-A1 — exemption.** The Graph's annunciator `ann` (Audio AA-27) is gated by `alarm_eligible`; Attention's breach-entry `attn` cadence (Attention AT-18, Audio AA-20) is Attention's own tell-contract event, not a Graph descriptor, and is preceded by a tell of at least `TELL_MIN_TICKS` by construction, so it is exempt from this gate and is never "the first warning". This closes CX-A1 (the Section H lint already carries the exemption). *Alternative considered:* a content guideline
